in_marathi.name: Pranali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of prana (life)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranali is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'prana', which refers to the life force or breath of living beings. This name is believed to signify a gift or grace of prana, symbolizing the continuation and flourishing of life. In Hindu mythology, Pranali is associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her nurturing and life-giving qualities.
